Customize your experience with stylish accessories, mobile printers like Hi·Print, and the Polaroid App for creative control and easy photo sharing. Sonar Autofocus Sonar autofocus uses ultrasonic waves to automatically measure the distance between the camera and your subject, adjusting the lens in real-time to ensure sharp, focused images. Whether you're photographing a person across the room or a close-up object, the camera does the work for you, eliminating the guesswork and improving the clarity of every shot. Hyperfocal 4-Lens System This advanced four-lens system is calibrated to a hyperfocal distance, meaning both your foreground and background stay in focus without any manual input. It's designed for fast, spontaneous shooting, allowing you to capture well-composed, crisp images whether you're taking portraits, landscapes, or street photography. Powerful Built-In Flash The Flip features Polaroid’s most powerful flash to date, automatically adjusting brightness based on the lighting around you. This ensures balanced exposure in every photo, whether you're indoors, outdoors, in low light, or bright sunlight. It helps eliminate harsh shadows and overexposed highlights, making your shots look polished and natural. Scene Analysis Intelligent scene analysis technology reads your shooting environment and optimizes exposure, flash strength, and shutter speed before each photo is taken. This means more consistent results and fewer failed shots. From bright daylight to dim interiors, the Flip automatically adapts to give you the best possible image. i-Type Film Compatibility The Polaroid Flip uses i-Type film, Polaroid’s latest generation of instant film, which develops into large, vibrant prints in the classic square format. Known for rich colors, soft textures, and retro charm, i-Type film gives your images a timeless, artistic look. It’s also more affordable than 600 film and doesn’t require a built-in battery, making it ideal for modern Polaroid cameras. Flip Design with Lens Protection True to its name, the Flip folds closed to protect the lens and internal components when not in use. This clamshell design is both stylish and functional, keeping your camera safe from dust, scratches, and damage during travel or everyday use. It also gives the camera a clean, minimalist profile when shut. On-Camera Display and Shooting Modes The built-in display lets you easily view camera settings like film count, battery life, and selected shooting mode. You can quickly switch between creative options—such as self-timer, double exposure, or flash control—right from the camera itself, no phone required. It’s designed for ease of use, even for first-time instant photographers. Creative Controls via Polaroid App Pair your Flip with the Polaroid app via Bluetooth to unlock powerful creative tools. Use the app to shoot remotely, manually adjust settings like exposure and aperture, or experiment with effects like light painting and double exposure. This level of control allows you to go beyond simple snapshots and create artistic, professional-style photos with ease.

In the system, the actual capacity is the labeled capacity of the hard disk/1.024/1.024/1.024, for example: 500G actually displays around 465G. Approximately calculated as indicated capacity * 0.93 Capacity:500GB Color:Black Material:ABS Package Contents: 1 * hard drive 1 * data cable 1 * OTG adapter Only the above package content, other products are not included. name: NOYAFA NF-8209 Anti-Interference Network Cable Tester, Power over Ethernet Detection, Wire Tracing, Port Flash, 600m Range, Black
description: The NOYAFA NF-8209 is an anti-interference network cable tester and wire tracer designed for IT professionals, network engineers, and field technicians who demand accurate, noise-free cable identification. Using advanced digital signal decoding technology, the NF-8209 eliminates false readings common in traditional analog tracers, delivering superior accuracy even when tracing cables on loaded gigabit switches. The emitter unit provides 6 essential testing functions in one portable device. Cable tracing features two modes — standard and anti-interference — with a maximum tracing distance of 600 meters when tracing energized cables. The receiver unit's adjustable sensitivity knob allows precise cable location, with signal strength and audio tone intensifying as the probe approaches the target wire. Wire mapping works with the included remote adapter for one-to-one pair testing, detecting open circuits, short circuits, and crossover conditions on both shielded and unshielded CAT5, CAT6, RJ45, and RJ11 cables. Cable length measurement covers a range of 2.5 to 200 meters, with the unique ability to display the length of each twisted pair individually on the LCD screen for detailed diagnostics. For network infrastructure troubleshooting, port flashing supports 10M/100M/1000M switch auto-negotiation — simply connect the target device to the emitter's Flash port to quickly locate the corresponding cable. During port flashing, an automatic link test runs simultaneously, displaying real-time switch/router speed, full-duplex or half-duplex mode, and auto-negotiation or forced-negotiation status. PoE detection tests both standard and non-standard Power over Ethernet from 5V to 60V DC with automatic AF/AT identification — connect any PoE device to the dedicated PoE test port for instant results. The included receiver unit features anti-interference and standard tracing modes, Non-Contact Voltage (NCV) detection for AC voltage safety verification, and a built-in LED flashlight for low-light work environments. The emitter's settings menu provides language selection, backlight timeout, auto power-off timer, contrast adjustment, and firmware version display. The product includes the NF-8209 emitter, receiver unit, remote adapter, 9V battery, alligator clip test leads (6P/8P), Type-C USB data cable, user manual, warranty card, and a carrying tool bag. The emitter measures 130 x 70 x 28mm and the receiver measures 210 x 43 x 27mm, making this complete network diagnostic kit highly portable for both field service and benchtop applications.

description: To meet the increasing needs and volumes of connected devices, Aruba Instant On is announcing its first Wi-Fi 6 access point: AP22. ORTHOGONAL FREQUENCY-DIVISION MULTIPLE ACCESS (OFDMA) Allows access points (APs) to handle multiple Wi-Fi 6-capable clients on each channel simultaneously- regardless of device or traffic type. This improves efficiency by boosting overall capacity, while reducing latency. TARGET WAKE TIME (TWT) Ideal for IoTs that communicate infrequently, TWT establishes a schedule for when clients need to communicate with an AP. This helps reduce power consumption, extending the battery life of clients. MULTIUSER, MULTIPLE INPUT, MULTIPLE OUTPUT (MU-MIMO) Allows you to serve multiple clients (Wi-Fi 5 and Wi-Fi 6) at the same time. 1024-QUADRATURE AMPLITUDE MODULATION (1024-QAM) Enables a 25% data increase over 256 QAM, improving throughput in your access points and devices. TRUSTED PLATFORM MODULE (TPM) All Aruba Instant On access points have an installed TPM for secure storage of credentials, keys, and boot codes. BASIC SERVICE SET COLORING (BSS COLORING) Allows the network to assign a "color" tag to a channel and reduce the threshold for interference. Network performance is improved because APs on the same channel can be closer together and still transmit at the same time-as long as they are different colors. ARUBA ADVANCED CELLULAR COEXISTENCE (ACC) Uses built-in filtering to automatically minimize the impact of interference from cellular networks, distributed antenna systems (DAS), and commercial small-cell or femtocell equipment. LOW DENSITY PARITY CHECK (LDPC) Delivers high-efficiency error correction for increased throughput. TRANSMIT BEAMFORMING (TXBF) Delivers increased signal reliability and range.

description: Higher Quality, Lower Prices Enhanced high performance ANSI/TIA/EIA 568A compliant Cat5E riser UTP bulk (LAN) cable for mission critical LAN applications or future proofing your Structured Cabling Systems. These Cat5E (LAN) bulk cables are characterized to meet gigabit networking requirements at affordable prices. Enhanced Category 5 Cable Cat 5e cable is an enhanced version of Cat 5 cmr that adds specifications for far end crosstalk. It was formally defined in 2001 in the TIA/EIA-568-B standard, which no longer recognizes the original Cat 5 riser specification. Although 1000BASE-T was designed for use with Cat 5 cable, the tighter specifications associated with Cat 5e riser cable and connectors make it an excellent choice for use with 1000BASE-T. Despite the stricter performance specifications, Cat 5e cmr cable does not enable longer cable distances for Ethernet networks: cables are still limited to a maximum of 328 ft (100 m) in length (normal practice is to limit fixed horizontal cables to 90 m to allow for up to 5 m of patch cable at each end). Cat 5e riser cable performance characteristics and test methods are defined in TIA/EIA-568-B.2-2001. Warranty 25 Years Warranty and Product Support

By capturing music at a higher rate than CD, increasing both audio samples per second and the bitrate accuracy of each sample, High-Resolution Audio offers a near-perfect capture of an artist’s music. Savor every breath and subtle movement for a truly emotional experience.</p><h3>Tight, Powerful Bass</h3><p>Through fine timing alignment across the entire frequency range, natural bass is realized. One listen and you will be mesmerized by the incredibly fast and powerful bass response that not only gives your music a solid foundation—it rocks your senses!</p><h3>Room-Filling Sound</h3><p>At first listen, the all new Core Series speakers will make your favorite audio tracks unfold throughout your listening environment, thanks to precise instrument reproduction, positioning, and even depth relative to an expansive soundstage.&nbsp;</p><h3>Wide-Dispersion Super Tweeter</h3><p>Prepare yourself for natural sounding vocals that shoot straight to the heart, thanks to the all-new Wide Dispersion Super Tweeter. The super tweeter is specifically designed to deliver ultra-responsive, high-frequency audio response (up to 50 kHz), ideal for High-Resolution listening, with wide directionality (sweet spot).</p><h3>Mica-Reinforced Drivers</h3><p>CS Series speakers utilize unique, foamed (dual-layer) mica woofer diaphragms-the upper surface delivers supple and faithful sound quality, while the bottom layer leverages low weight with great strength for powerful bass response.</p><h3>Created For Sound</h3><p>Drawing inspiration from our high-end SSAR Series Speakers, the Core Series speaker lineup leverage the same attention to detail, carefully component selection, and meticulous construction which altogether deliver moving audio performances that will transport you into the recording.&nbsp;</p>

name: Rockville RPA60BT V2 Bundle: 1000W Bluetooth Karaoke Amplifier Mixer, RockSlim 5.25 inch White Wall Mount Speakers, 2-items
description: Overview: The Rockville RPA60BT V2 Bundle combines a 1000 watt peak 2 channel Bluetooth karaoke amplifier mixer with a pair of Rockville RockSlim white 5.25 inch wall mount speakers. The included RockSlim speaker pair handles 240 watts peak and 80 watts RMS per pair, giving the system clear output for everyday entertainment. Bluetooth, USB, FM radio, 3.5mm aux, optical, coaxial, and RCA inputs make it easy to connect TVs, phones, media players, and other audio sources. Dual front microphone inputs support vocal mixing with tone, volume, and echo control. Design: The RPA60BT V2 features removable rack ears for 19 inch rack mounting, a multicolor display, bass and treble controls, balance adjustment, preset EQ modes, and a remote control. The RockSlim speakers use white ABS cabinets, shielded grilles, built in wall brackets, recessed wire terminals, and molded wire grooves for a cleaner wall mounted setup. Reliability: Twin fan cooling helps the amplifier maintain steady operation during longer sessions, while the RockSlim speakers are built for lightweight wall placement and daily use. The system includes practical inputs, expandable outputs, and durable cabinet construction for consistent home audio, karaoke, and general entertainment performance.

name: Sangean Rcr22 Am/Fm Atomic Clock Radio With Lcd Display
description: Continuing in the footsteps of its predecessors, this Sangean Atomic Clock Radio is the clock that you set once and forget. Once the signal is found it will synchronize every hour to ensure that it is the right time, all the time. Once the clock is set you can program the dual alarms to wake to your favorite AM or FM station or take advantage of the Humane Waking System that begins with a low volume beep and gradually increases in intensity to slowly wake you instead of receiving a firm jolt that others provide. For the ambitious nappers of the world, the clock features a NAP function that can be set to wake you in 10 minute intervals up to 2 hours without resetting the alarms so that you can get the most of your nap. There is also a handy sleep timer that allows you to fall asleep listening to your favorite radio station from 15 minutes up to 2 hours. With the aux input you can connect your or a CD player to enjoy your favorite Soothing Sounds CD or digitl music collection to fall asleep. With all these features, it is truly the easiest and last Alarm Clock Radio you will ever have to buy.

name: Yamaha HS8 SG 8" Powered Studio Monitor (Each), Slate Grey
description: This proven 2-way powered studio monitor produces the flat, natural sound quality professionals count on to consistently create honest, accurate mixes. With its 8" woofer and 1" dome tweeter, the Yamaha HS8 SG carries enough weight to give you full-bodied sound without a subwoofer, yet also delivers the clarity you expect in the midrange, and the finesse to reproduce clean, smooth highs. Since every studio is unique, the Yamaha HS8 SG active monitor lets you tailor its response to fit your space with custom room control and frequency response switches. So, whether you set up your monitors in the corners of a makeshift bedroom studio, or you have the luxury of a full-size professional studio, the HS8 SG gives you the tools to mix with confidence. High-performance Speakers and Mounting System The iconic white-cone speakers used in the HS Series monitors deliver superlative audio performance that is further enhanced by a carefully engineered mounting system. A system of screws and a specially designed mounting ring eliminates spurious vibration and resonance, allowing the speaker to deliver its full sonic potential. Another feature that boosts woofer performance is a magnet selected to produce accurate, solid low-end response. The tweeter frames employ an advanced smooth-contour design that minimizes losses so that high-frequency details come through with remarkable accuracy. The extra thickness of the tweeter frame also minimizes resonance that can interfere with high-end clarity. The overall result is extraordinarily smooth, accurate response throughout the audio spectrum. The Benefits of Built-in Power and Bi-amplification Powered, bi-amplified monitor speakers simply make the most electrical and sonic sense, and that's why they have become the first choice of sound professionals the world over for nearfield and midfield monitoring applications. In addition to the obvious advantage that you don't need separate power amplifiers, the fact that power and speakers are integrated in one unit means that the amplifiers can be perfectly matched to the characteristics of the speaker units used so you get consistently superior performance with any source in just about any listening environment. Bi-amplification means that separate power amplifiers are used to drive the low-mid and high-frequency speaker units, and this eliminates interaction between the units as well as the response and phase anomalies introduced by passive crossover networks. Both speaker units can function at optimum performance levels for correspondingly high overall sonic quality. Large Magnets in an Advanced Magnetic Circuit Design What you'll hear and feel—but not likely see—is the HS8 SG's extra-large magnet under the hood. In combination with an advanced magnetic circuit design, the HS8 SG's magnet provides a powerful, uniform, tightly controlled flux field that results in exceptionally smooth response and dynamic capability over a wider frequency range. Portable, Versatile Monitoring for Your Audio Workstation All you really need for top-class stereo production capability is a good audio workstation and a pair of HS8 SG monitors. A system like this is not only portable and extremely easy to set up anywhere you need it, it can deliver outstanding monitoring performance that will let you get your mixes just right. The response control features of the HS8 SG lets you tweak it for the best response no matter where you set it up. Serious Surround Production Although stereo is still the most common format for basic music listening, 5.1 surround has become the audio format of choice for today's advanced visual media, and is beginning to be recognized as a superior vehicle for pure musical enjoyment as well. But to properly mix and produce surround sound you need a good 5.1 monitoring system. The Yamaha HS8 SG is the perfect choice if you want mega-studio monitoring performance, but you don't have a mega-studio budget. Optimum Response in any Room Speaker response can vary greatly depending on the size, shape and surface acoustics of the room in which they're used, as well as how they're placed within that environment. The HS8 SG gives you extra room-matching and speaker placement versatility with ROOM CONTROL, MID EQ and HIGH TRIM response control switches that are specifically designed to compensate for common acoustic deficiencies and monitoring needs. The ROOM CONTROL switch, for example, can be used to compensate for the unnatural low-end exaggeration that usually occurs when speakers are placed close to walls or in corners. The MID EQ switch gives you subtle midrange boost and cut options in addition to flat response, while the HIGH TRIM switch offer the same type of response-tailoring capability for the high frequencies.

name: M-Audio, 1 Acoustic Guitar Effect Pedal, 16-bit / 48kHz Micro DAC
description: Micro DAC is a USB digital-to-analog DAC converter with two outputs, one analog and one digital optical. It's ideal for converting the audio from your computer into a high-quality analog format without needing to carry anything larger than a flash drive. The sound quality available from the typical headphone jack on a portable device or coming from the standard-issue soundcard found in virtually every computer leaves a lot to be desired. Micro DAC delivers a marked upgrade in sound quality, compared to just plugging your headphones directly into your unit's headphone jack. Use the 1/8-inch analog output to connect any headphones, and enjoy vibrant high-fidelity sound. There is a gain switch that boosts the signal level, so you can drive even high-impedance headphones to a robust loudness level. And since virtually all high-quality audio equipment has an optical digital input, Micro DAC's optical digital output is perfect for driving that equipment with a pure digital signal - especially valuable since most computers to not have a digital output. Micro DAC has a rugged aluminum housing and is USB-bus-powered. Getting professional-quality audio from your computer couldn't be easier! Frequently Asked Questions Does the Micro DAC require any drivers? The Micro DAC is class compliant with both Mac and Windows operating systems, meaning it does not require any additional drivers. Class-compliant devices are designed to use standard drivers that are built into the Mac and Windows OS. This makes the device quick and easy to setup. How do I set this up on Mac/Windows? Because the Micro DAC is class compliant, setting it up is as easy as selecting it as your playback device in your systems Sound Preferences. Here's a quick way to do that: Navigate to your Control Panel Select Sound Under the Playback tab, find the device labeled USB Audio DAC Click the Set Default button at the bottom of the window to select it as your playback device HitOK to exit the window Navigate to your System Preferences Select Sound Pick the Output tab at the top of your sound window Find and select USB Audio DAC from the list of available output Alternatively on a Mac, you can also hold down the Option key and click on the speaker icon at the top right of your screen to select your input and output devices. How do I adjust the volume? The Micro DAC will be essentially replacing the sound card in your computer, so the volume will be adjusted the same way you would adjust volume when using the headphone output or built in speakers on your computer. Some laptops and computers will have volume up or down buttons available on the keyboard, but otherwise this can normally be adjusted by clicking on the speaker icon in the top right of your screen Mac or bottom right of your screen windows and using the slider to adjust the output volume. What is the impedance switch for? The impedance switch is used to adjust the output volume to compensate for headphones with high or low impedance values. When referring to headphones, impedance is essentially the amount of resistance being applied to the incoming audio signal. So, headphones with a higher impedance value require more power in order to provide the same amount of volume as a pair of low impedance headphones.
